errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns grey to 2022 and violet (lila) to 2023. The correct colors are blue for 2021, violet for 2022, and grey for 2023.
The description incorrectly assigns 11.4% to copper for 2023 in Germany. The correct value for copper in 2023 is 2.2%, while 11.4% corresponds to nickel.
The description incorrectly assigns 2.2% to nickel for 2023 in Germany. The correct value for nickel in 2023 is 11.4%, while 2.2% corresponds to copper.

The description incorrectly assigns 4.4% to aluminum for 2022 and 1.7% to 2023 in the EU. The correct values are 2.8% for 2022 and 1.7% for 2023 (which is correct for 2023 but misassigned for 2022). The value 4.4% corresponds to copper in 2021.
The description incorrectly assigns 5.1% to copper for 2021 in the EU. The correct value for copper in 2021 is 4.4%, while 5.1% corresponds to 2022.
The description incorrectly assigns 2.8% to copper for 2022 in the EU. The correct value for copper in 2022 is 5.1%, while 2.8% corresponds to aluminum in 2022.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart shows the share of Russian imports of selected industrial raw materials in percent.
